method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A flat mottled card with a 27 px square.
notes.fix: A 35 degree oblique showing a lit cliff and its cast, the plateau two thirds of the frame, raised neighbours.

notes.problem: An evenly lit mid-grey card, a groove through the dek, halo plates.
notes.fix: A 35 degree oblique with a raking key, the pool tight on Silverton, no groove under the type.

notes.problem: A flat mid-grey noise square, the parcel a speck.
notes.fix: Crop to the ten miles around Silverton, cut the escarpment into the height field under a grazing key.
Cloth ribbons tied at the stake top, the nearest stake a third of the frame tall with a cast.

notes.problem: A lilac pasture with no pool, the two lines as one pole and one tower.
notes.fix: The pool on the substation and nearest stakes, receding H-frames and lattice towers landing on the yard.

notes.problem: The BRISCOE WIND leader lands on a bare pole.
notes.fix: Retarget it to a turbine, let the pasture beyond the pool fall to black.

notes.problem: Panels out of line with the louvres, the pole line invisible.
notes.fix: Glow behind the louvre blades, a lit pole line.

notes.problem: Saturated orange stripes off the louvres, dead grass below.
notes.fix: A warm sodium glow behind the louvres spilling onto a caliche pad, camera lower.

notes.problem: Bays laid over the louvres, empty grass below.
notes.fix: Glow through the kit louvres, camera lower and in.

notes.problem: A smooth box with slab fins and disc bushings.
notes.fix: Pressed panels on header pipes, skirted porcelain sheds, crisp chain link.

notes.problem: An anonymous grey box at feed size.
notes.fix: Pull back so the gantry, road and pasture fence share the frame.

notes.problem: Corrugated siding and streaking post casts.
notes.fix: Lower ridges, straw patches in the L, shorter edge casts.
A grazing key so each furrow casts, darker troughs, a scale figure.

notes.problem: A heap of rings and a doubled post.
notes.fix: Linked chain through both stiles, one gate post.

notes.problem: Loose floating rings and a black centre mass.
notes.fix: One continuous chain to the padlock, galvanized posts catching the key.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
shortfall: at the round cap the finished deck ships at 7.0, 1.0 under the 8.0 top rung. Name that in the email and the run record
craft_note: at the round cap the craft floor stands down. The art median 6.5 is under 8.5 and the deck ships as it is. Name it in the run record
